tree.heading: Amounts.—
tree.text: There is authorized to be appropriated to carry out this chapter $2,500,000 for each fiscal year, of which—

children.text: $2,000,000 shall be used to carry out section 308302 of this title; and
$500,000 shall be used to carry out section 308303 of this title.

tree.heading: Limitation.—
tree.text: No amount may be appropriated for the purposes of this chapter except to the Secretary for carrying out the responsibilities of the Secretary as set forth in this chapter.
